This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/parabolic-flight-phase-cs defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
steady-1g Steady 1gLevel flight at standard gravity before or between parabolas
pull-up Pull-UpHypergravity phase during aircraft pitch-up (1.5-1.8g)
microgravity MicrogravityFree-fall phase at approximately 0g during parabolic arc
pull-out Pull-OutHypergravity recovery phase during aircraft pitch-down (1.5-1.8g)
